media.note: Its Gigantamax Form and signature move Pyro Ball built directly on its soccer striker design introduced in Galar.

community: Cinderace became a competitive staple soon after its release, prized for the raw power of Pyro Ball and for a design fans immediately read as a soccer striker.

why.text: Cinderace visibly gets pumped up when a crowd has cheered it on mid-match.
Cinderace handles both offense and defense equally well, a balance that sets it apart from a pure striker.
Cinderace's flair for showboating shows a Pokémon that plays entirely on its own terms.
